chunks: We gave guidance to Ishmael, Elisha and Jonah and Lot; And We favoured them over the other people of the world,

key_terms.الْيَسَعَ: Elisha, a prophet in the Bible
key_terms.كَلًّا: Kale (often identified as Ezekiel or a specific title)
key_terms.يُونُسَ: Jonah, known for his time in the whale

ai.seo_question: Who are the prophets mentioned in Surah Al-An'am verse 86 as being favored by God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to highlight the spiritual superiority of these prophets not merely as individuals but as representatives of divine guidance, with some scholars linking 'Yasa' (Elisha) to the broader lineage of prophetic succession. The mention of these specific figures underscores the continuity of monotheism and the universal scope of God's mercy, reinforcing the concept of 'Fadl' (divine grace) that distinguishes the chosen from the general populace. This elevation serves as a theological basis for understanding the hierarchy of prophets and their unique roles in establishing divine law.
